question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **"Consientious."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is **'Conscientious.'**
 
• The word means to do something with great care and diligence. ((व्‍यक्ति) ईमानदार, कर्तव्यनिष्‍ठ)
 
 
• **Example**: *He’s a **conscientious**__ worker.*
 
 
 
• The incorrect spelling in Option 4 adds an extra **'i' **between** 's' **and **'e.'**

The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Moan** - to utter a low sound expressing physical or emotional pain. (दर्द या दुख आदि से कराहना, क्रंदन करना)
 
• **Option 2: Definite** - certain or clear. (निश्चित या स्पष्ट)
 
• **Option 3: Extinguish** - to put out or extinguish a fire or flame. ((आग) बुझाना)
